meta.description: Lightweight headless VM abstraction for AI agents — three-tier isolation (WASM/gVisor/Firecracker)

pillars.name: Governance
pillars.notes: CLAUDE.md, CHANGELOG.md present. ADR.md as inline guide. Strong README.

pillars.name: ADR
pillars.notes: ADR.md as single file covers decisions. Missing formal ADR-0001 numbering.

pillars.name: CI/CD
pillars.notes: No CI/CD config detected (no .github/workflows, no Makefile CI targets). Critical gap.

pillars.name: FR/CIV Taxonomy
pillars.notes: No FR-CIV-* references found. Not mapped to registry taxonomy.

pillars.name: Test Coverage
pillars.notes: Go test files exist (_test.go pattern) but coverage not measured.

pillars.name: Documentation
pillars.notes: README.md, ADR.md, CHANGELOG.md present. No docs/ directory for detailed spec.

pillars.name: SEC (Security)
pillars.notes: 3-tier isolation is strong architectural security. No .trufflehog.yml or security policy.

pillars.name: Observability
pillars.notes: No structured observability (tracing/metrics/logging) built in. Go-native logging only.

pillars.name: Performance
pillars.notes: WASM tier is fast. Performance benchmarks not documented.

pillars.name: Portability
pillars.notes: Go compiles cross-platform. Firecracker tier is Linux-only. WASM tier is universal.

pillars.name: API
pillars.notes: Go package API exported. No gRPC/REST surface or OpenAPI spec.

pillars.name: Modularity
pillars.notes: 3-tier isolation is inherently modular. Each tier is independent.

pillars.name: Dependency
pillars.notes: go.mod present. Dependencies managed but not audited (no cargo-deny equivalent in Go ecosystem).

pillars.name: Versioning
pillars.notes: CHANGELOG.md has versions. No semantic versioning tags found on repo.

pillars.name: Changelog
pillars.notes: CHANGELOG.md present and well-maintained. Covers recent changes.

pillars.name: Build
pillars.notes: `go build` works. No cross-compilation or build matrix configured.

pillars.name: Release
pillars.notes: No release workflow (GoReleaser, GitHub Releases, or similar).

pillars.name: Compliance
pillars.notes: No license header scanning. No compliance check in CI.

pillars.name: Accessibility
pillars.notes: CLI tool — no accessibility considerations documented.

pillars.name: Localization
pillars.notes: English-only. No i18n framework.

pillars.name: Telemetry
pillars.notes: Basic Go log package. No structured telemetry export (OTel).

pillars.name: Backup
pillars.notes: Git as backup. No VM state backup/restore documented.

pillars.name: Disaster Recovery
pillars.notes: No DR plan documented.

pillars.name: Migration

pillars.name: Deprecation

pillars.name: Code Review

pillars.name: Technical Debt
